reviews.review: Best Purge the xeno simulatore ever.

Approximate amount of time to 100%: 80 hours
Estimated achievement difficulty: 9.5/10
Minimum number of playthroughs needed: 1+, you can reload areas.

Multiplayer achievements: Yes, Really Grindy ones (servers still somewhat populated)
Missable achievements: Yes, multiple "use only this weapon" achievements
Grinding Achievements:Yes, A couple.
DLC-Only achievements:Yes, Chaos Invasion includes the hardest achievement "Heretic"
Time-gated achievements: No
RNG-achievements: No (It's random when people are playing :3 as you may wait for hours in a loby)
Does difficulty affect achievements: Yes, Finish the game on Hard.
Unobtainable/glitched achievements: Yes, Almost nobody plays the DLC chaos invasion so unless you have a crew of 4 dedicated players i'd consider these achievements impossible.

Boy I love this game, it's Warhammer in all of it's glory however the achievements are no cake. Grinding the multiplayer wastes hours of your life and you're almost never going to get the 500~ kill-streaks and others the weapon achievement require without boosting with other players, The "Heretic" Achievement is almost impossible even with a crew of 4, forget doing it alone. Overall I'd recommend this game if you're NOT a perfections or else you'll almost go insane.
on se sent puissant ^^ difficulté pas mal ^^ tres bon jeux bien sympa :)

In summary, you shoot stuff and you smash stuff. It's extremely satisfying and pretty relaxing. Totally recommend it. However, the story is a bit too short, and it's the only weak point I could think of.

I really enjoyed this game in its entirety. It's one of the few good Warhammer 40k games other than Dawn of War, and is one of the few shooter games I've enjoyed in the past decade. The singleplayer campaign and multiplayer options were both excellent. The story was engaging, and the gameplay was extremely satisfying. It truly hurts my soul that a sequel was never made for this.
